source.name: SEN12TS
source.full_dataset_scope_note: The complete public collection is much larger than the project budget; only the fixed subset below is a candidate core dataset.

metadata_query.selection: lexicographically first 400 label TIFF keys in each region; for each label choose the lexicographically first matching S1/S2 basename with the same location prefix

model_contract_candidate.optical: S2 L2A 12 spectral bands; ignore SCL/cloud-mask layers
model_contract_candidate.sar: S1 raw current-time VH,VV layers only (2 channels), deterministically reordered to canonical VV,VH; ignore auxiliary temporal/InSAR layers
model_contract_candidate.derived_input: deterministic 120x120 crops/stitches, parent-tile split before cropping
model_contract_candidate.raw_label_source: ESA WorldCover 2020 v100 as documented by SEN12TS
model_contract_candidate.quality_control: SCL/cloud-mask may be read only for a pre-registered optical-quality exclusion; it is never a model input, target, metric, or research task

closure_requirements_before_download: freeze exact 1200-row object manifest with object keys, sizes and provider ETags
verify license attribution and non-commercial use terms for data and WorldCover-derived labels
perform remote shape/dtype/value audit without training
freeze parent-first spatial/block split and sealed-test manifest
reconcile downloaded bytes, extracted peak and cache ledger against a 45,000,000,000-byte hard stop
confirm CROMA 12+2 input compatibility, explicit SAR VH,VV to VV,VH reorder, and native 11-class labels

supported_now: object existence, pair matching, advertised license, metadata byte totals
pending: actual TIFF shape/dtype, class frequencies, split leakage, ETag/hash reproducibility after transfer, loader compatibility
not_claimed: accuracy, robustness, cross-region generalization, or any experiment result
